scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Hello~!!
Our ^009CFFScroll Publishing Company^000000
is professionally publishing
tales.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
你好~！！
我们^009CFF卷轴出版公司^000000
专业出版
故事书。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
We established
^3163FFMomotaro Field Trip^000000
to celebrate ^009CFF<Momotaro Story>^000000 selling over a million copies.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
为了庆祝^009CFF《桃太郎故事》^000000
销量突破一百万册，
我们建立了
^3163FF桃太郎郊游^000000。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Become Momotaro and eliminate
Dokebis, just like in the story!
There will also be rewards.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
化身桃太郎，
像故事里那样消灭土人吧！
还有奖励哦。

scripts.text: What is Momotaro Story?
scripts.translation: 什么是桃太郎故事？

scripts.text: I want to try!
scripts.translation: 我想试试！

scripts.text: I'm busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我现在很忙...

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Eh~!? How can you not know about
Momotaro? Don't they have this
tale in Midgard?? Well...
Let me tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
诶~！？你怎么会不知道
桃太郎呢？米德加尔特
没有这个故事吗？？好吧...
让我给你讲讲这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Long ago, there lived an old married couple. They were happy, but didn't have any children.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
很久以前，有一对老夫妻。他们很幸福，但没有孩子。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
One day, while old lady was doing the laundy, she found a humongous
peach. She cut it in half and...
'Poof!' There was a baby inside!
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
有一天，老妇人在洗衣服时，
发现了一个巨大的桃子。她把它切成两半...
“噗！”里面竟然有一个婴儿！

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
The old man and lady were shocked.
They decided to adopt that baby,
and give him their love...
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
老人和老妇人惊呆了。
他们决定收养这个婴儿，
并给他满满的爱...

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
That baby grew so fast, like that beanstalk from 'Jack and Beanstalk,' and became a strong boy in only a few days.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
那个婴儿长得飞快，就像《杰克与魔豆》里的豆茎一样，
几天之内就长成了一个强壮的男孩。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
That boy's name was...
<Momotaro>!!!
Momotaro traveled to eliminate
dokebis that were harassing
the towners.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
那个男孩的名字是...
《桃太郎》！！！
桃太郎出发去消灭
骚扰镇民的土人。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
He became friends with
^3163FFYoyo, Picky, and Desert Wolf^000000
and eliminated all of the Dokebis. Then he lived happily ever after with the old couple.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
他和
^3163FF溜溜猴、小鸡和沙漠之狼^000000
成为了朋友，
并消灭了所有的土人。然后他和老夫妻幸福地生活在一起。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
How was it?
Great, right?
I mean, this story sold a million copies!
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
怎么样？
很棒吧？
毕竟，这个故事卖了一百万册呢！

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Yay-! You look excited!
You'll be ready to go soon.
Please fill out this registration card.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
耶-！你看起来很兴奋！
你很快就会准备好的。
请填写这张登记表。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
....................
......Mm.....Let's see.....
.............Good!
Alright, then!
Let it begin~~~!!!!!!!!!
<Momotaro Field Trip>~!

[Publisher]
Hmm~
Why don't you train yourself more
and come back?
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
嗯~
你为什么不多加练习
再回来呢？

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Eh?
...But there are sweet rewards waiting...
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
诶？
...但是有甜美的奖励在等着你呢...

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Ah~ What nice weather!
This is the perfect weather to do some reading.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
啊~天气真好！
这是读书的好天气。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
How was it? Did you have fun?
I hope you had a good time
during the field trip.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
感觉如何？玩得开心吗？
希望你在郊游中度过了一段美好的时光。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
This is your reward for you.
Please continue to enjoy stories~
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
这是给你的奖励。
请继续享受故事吧~

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Welcome to <Momotaro Field Trip>
scripts.translation:
[聪]
欢迎来到《桃太郎郊游》

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
I'm Satoshi who is in charge of the waiting room in <Momotaro Field Trip>.
scripts.translation:
[聪]
我是聪，负责《桃太郎郊游》的候诊室。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Originally, I was working for the publishing company, but we lacked workers for the Field Trip...
But working here is much better!
Now I just watch people trying to accomplish the mission. Heh hehe~
scripts.translation:
[聪]
原本我在出版社工作，但郊游活动人手不足...
不过在这里工作好多了！
我现在只需要看着大家努力完成任务。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
................
Just kidding
*Wipes away sweat*

[Satoshi]
Well, let me explain
about the rules in the Field Trip.
scripts.translation:
[聪]
那么，让我来解释一下郊游的规则。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
First of all...Did you hear
about the story from the publisher?
scripts.translation:
[聪]
首先...你听到出版商讲的故事了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Hehe...Good.
Momotaro Story is our
pride. It's the best story EVER.
Hahahah!!!
scripts.translation:
[聪]
嘿嘿...很好。
桃太郎的故事是我们的骄傲。这是有史以来最好的故事。
哈哈哈!!!

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
...Hmmhmm.

[Satoshi]
The Field Trip is simple.
Go inside and eliminate
Dokebis bravely!!!
Just like Momotaro!!!
Understand? Bravely!!!
scripts.translation:
[聪]
郊游很简单。
进去勇敢地消灭土人!!!
就像桃太郎一样!!!
明白了吗？要勇敢!!!

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
In addition, there are three
things you need to know.
scripts.translation:
[聪]
此外，有三件事你需要知道。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
First....
You can't come back once you clear the field trip. Keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[聪]
第一....
一旦完成郊游，你就不能回来了。请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Secondly....
Q-pet is prohibited
inside of the field trip.
If you are with a pet,
please change it to egg status.
scripts.translation:
[聪]
第二....
郊游内部禁止携带Q版宠物。
如果你带着宠物，请将其变为蛋的状态。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
And finally...
One person can be on the
field trip for 6 minutes.
scripts.translation:
[聪]
最后...
每个人在郊游中的时间为6分钟。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Well then, please
wait your turn
in the waiting room.
Good luck in fighting!!
scripts.translation:
[聪]
那么，请在候诊室等待你的回合。
祝你战斗顺利!!

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Eh? You can't just
skip the story
when you enter field trip!!
I can't allow you to do that
as Momotaro's fan!!!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
诶？进入郊游时不能跳过故事!!
作为桃太郎的粉丝，我不能允许你这样做!!!

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Please listen to the story
from the publisher.
Thank you.
Bye~~
scripts.translation:
[助手]
请听出版商讲的故事。
谢谢。
再见~~

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Oh my...Are you alright?
I thought it was entertaining but maybe it was too hard for you?
scripts.translation:
[聪]
天哪...你没事吧？
我觉得这很有趣，但也许对你来说太难了？

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Now what are you going to do?
Do you want to go in again?
scripts.translation:
[聪]
现在你打算怎么办？
你想再进去一次吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No, I want to go back
scripts.translation: 不，我想回去

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
The more effort you put into this, the sweeter victory will taste.
Good luck in fighting!
scripts.translation:
[聪]
你付出的努力越多，胜利的滋味就越甜美。
祝你战斗顺利！

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Well, I guess the reality of the situation is that you just can't fulfill the role of Momotaro...
Still, don't be depressed.
scripts.translation:
[聪]
看来现实情况是，你无法胜任桃太郎的角色...
不过，别灰心。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
I think you've gained enough experience from the field trip.
scripts.translation:
[聪]
我想你在郊游中已经获得了足够的经验。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
If you hear a good story,
Please, contact our
publishing company.
Bye-
scripts.translation:
[助手]
如果您听到好故事，
请联系我们的
出版公司。
再见-

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Woohoo~ Congratulations!!
You were so great!
scripts.translation:
[聪]
哇哦~恭喜！！
你太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
It is time to say good bye.
If you hear a good story,
Please, contact our
publishing company.
Bye-
scripts.translation:
[聪]
是时候说再见了。
如果您听到好故事，
请联系我们的
出版公司。
再见-

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Woohoo~ Congratulations!!
You were so great!!
Even though your finish was kind of weak...
scripts.translation:
[聪]
哇哦~恭喜！！
你太棒了！！
虽然你的结局有点弱...

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
It is time to say good bye.
If you hear a good story,
Please, contact our
publishing company.
Bye-
scripts.translation:
[聪]
是时候说再见了。
如果您听到好故事，
请联系我们的
出版公司。
再见-

[Grandma]

scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
亲爱的!!有人黑了我的账号，偷走了我的装备!!

scripts.text:
[Grandpa]
Hmm. The Chief said Dokebi earned 20 million zeny by hacking others' accounts...
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
嗯。首领说土人通过黑别人的账号赚了2000万Zeny...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Dohhhhhhh!!!!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
呜呜呜呜!!!!

scripts.text:
[Grandpa]
....Huh I've heard that somewhere.. .....
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
....嗯，我在哪里听说过... .....

scripts.text:
[Grandpa]
Anyway, Momotaro...
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
总之，桃太郎...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa]
As you know, since we towners spend our time sitting and chatting,
we can't kill Dokebis because we're low level, so...Please do it for us.
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
你知道的，因为我们镇民整天坐着聊天，
等级太低杀不了土人，所以...请替我们做吧。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Momotaro...
I really wanted to give you
a handmade ^3163FFYummiest Red Potion in the whole world^000000 ...but...
.....I failed to make them ....
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
桃太郎...
我真的很想给你
亲手做的^3163FF世界上最美味的红色药水^000000 ...但是...
.....我没能做出来 ....

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
...I'm sorry. I should have been leveling up before...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
...对不起。我应该先升级的...*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Grandma & Grandpa]
So...Do me this favor, kid~
scripts.translation:
[爷爷奶奶]
那么...拜托你了，小孩~

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Hoho~ Good.
I've been watching you in the VIP room. You were really something.
I was truly amazed.
scripts.translation:
[教练]
呵呵~ 很好。
我一直在VIP室观察你。你真的很厉害。
我真是惊叹不已。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
I thought you were really
Momotaro in the story!
Hohohoho...
scripts.translation:
[教练]
我觉得你简直就是
故事里的桃太郎！
呵呵呵...

scripts.text: Well, well. It is nothing~
scripts.translation: 哎呀，没什么~

scripts.text: It was boring.
scripts.translation: 很无聊。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
...Hohoho..
Don't be so proud of yourself.
When I was young like you,
I squashed Dokebi with
my little finger. Hohoho~
scripts.translation:
[教练]
...呵呵呵..
别太得意了。
像我像你这么大的时候，
我用小拇指就能捏死土人。呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Coach]
..............
...Don't give me that look.
I was just joking. Hmmhmm.
scripts.translation:
[教练]
..............
...别用那种眼神看我。
我只是在开玩笑。嗯嗯。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Now, the Momotaro story is over.
You can get your reward when you talk to the Publisher lady you saw first.
scripts.translation:
[教练]
好了，桃太郎的故事结束了。
你可以去找你一开始遇到的那位出版商女士领取奖励了。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Don't lose your high self-esteem
in the future. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[教练]
以后不要失去你的高自尊。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
.....!!!!!!
....Hohohoho..
You're pretty funny.
Alright, hot stuff.
Do you want to listen to my proposal?
scripts.translation:
[教练]
.....!!!!!!
....呵呵呵..
你还挺有趣的。
好吧，厉害的角色。
你想听听我的提议吗？

scripts.text:
[Coach]
At this point I'm supposed to send you back...BUT!
I really want to know
what you are capable of. Hehe~
Hohoho~
scripts.translation:
[教练]
按理说我现在应该把你送回去了...但是！
我真的想知道
你的极限在哪里。嘿嘿~
呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Coach]
So, I will give you a chance.
But if you fail,
^3163FFyou can't take this challenge.^000000
Also, this mission will be pretty hard.
scripts.translation:
[教练]
所以，我会给你一个机会。
但是如果你失败了，
^3163FF你就不能再接受这个挑战了。^000000
另外，这个任务会相当困难。

scripts.text: Nah.. I'm good.
scripts.translation: 不...我没事。

scripts.text: Bring it on, foo'!
scripts.translation: 放马过来吧，老家伙！

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Hoho~I understand...
You must be exhausted from the previous battle. It would have been a grand battle, though...
scripts.translation:
[教练]
呵呵~ 我明白了...
你肯定是被之前的战斗累坏了。不过那确实是一场精彩的战斗...

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Now, the Momotaro story is over.
You can get your reward
when you talk to
the Publisher lady you first spoke to.
scripts.translation:
[教练]
好了，桃太郎的故事结束了。
你可以去找你一开始交谈的那位出版商女士
领取奖励了。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Don't lose your high self-esteem
in the future. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[教练]
以后不要失去你的高自尊。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Hohoho~ I like your attitude.
Now, this is the last battle!
Show me what you got.
I'm looking forward to this.
scripts.translation:
[教练]
呵呵呵~ 我喜欢你的态度。
现在，这是最后一战！
让我看看你的实力。
我很期待。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Boom bam Boooom!!!
Tada~~~ !
scripts.translation:
[教练]
轰隆 轰隆 轰隆！！！
太棒了~~~！

scripts.text:
[Coach]
( Clap- Clap- Clap- )
scripts.translation:
[教练]
( 鼓掌- 鼓掌- 鼓掌- )

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Hohoho~ You are really something.
You've got the moves, kiddo.
I'll give you that.
scripts.translation:
[教练]
呵呵呵~ 你真的很厉害。
你身手不错，小鬼。
我承认这一点。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Well, time's up so...
Let me show you the exit.
I had a great time...
Don't forget to get your reward~
scripts.translation:
[教练]
时间到了，所以...
让我带你去出口吧。
和你在一起很开心...
记得去领取你的奖励哦~

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Hey. You look really heavy.
Don't you have trouble walking?
I'm sorry, but there is no space
to put down your stuff in my shop.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
嘿。你看起来好重啊。
走路不费劲吗？
抱歉，我的店里没有空间让你放下这些东西。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Put some of your stuff away somewhere.
Why are you carrying so much...?
Huhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
把一些东西收起来吧。
你为什么背了这么多东西...？
呼呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Training to slice raw fish
daily will make you a master sushi chef.
So don't waste your time in here, and learn what you are good at.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
每天练习切生鱼片，你就能成为寿司大师。
所以不要在这里浪费时间，去学你擅长的东西吧。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh! I really appreciate it.
Right on time!
I really need them to make a dessert.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哦！非常感谢。
准时到了！
我正好需要它们来做甜点。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Thanks. It's nothing, but
I will give you my shop's special cuisine, Fish Slice, in return.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
谢谢。虽然不值什么，
但我会用我店里的特色料理——生鱼片作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Here's 15 fish slices.
Please enjoy this food with your friends.
And come back whenever you miss the flavor of Amatsu cuisine.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
这是15份生鱼片。
请和朋友一起享用。
如果想念樱花城料理的味道，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh man, you didn't prepare
what I asked for...
Do not forget what I asked.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哎呀，你没准备我要求的东西...
别忘了我让你带什么。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
10 ^0000FFCandy^000000
You didn't forget it, right?
Bring me these supplies, please.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
10个 ^0000FF糖果^000000
你没忘吧？
请把这些材料带给我。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh! I really appreciate it.
Right on time!
I need them to make a sauce.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哦！非常感谢。
准时到了！
我正好需要它们来做酱汁。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Thanks. It is nothing, but
I will give you two sets of Sushi in return.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
谢谢。虽然不值什么，
但我会用两份寿司作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Share it with your friends
and family members.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
和朋友家人一起分享吧。
欢迎再次光临。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh man, you didn't prepare
what I asked for...
Do not forget what I asked.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哎呀，你没准备我要求的东西...
别忘了我让你带什么。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
10 ^0000FFCrab Shells^000000...
You didn't forget it, right?
Bring me these supplies, please.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
10个 ^0000FF螃蟹外壳^000000...
你没忘吧？
请把这些材料带给我。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh! I really appreciate it.
Right on time!
I was preparing appetizers...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哦！非常感谢。
准时到了！
我正在准备开胃菜...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Thanks. It is nothing but
I will give you several sets of Sushi in return.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
谢谢。虽然不值什么，
但我会用几份寿司作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
These are for three people,
so share them with your friends.
Come back again if you feel like helping out some more.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
这些够三个人吃，
请和朋友分享。
如果想再帮忙，欢迎回来。

scripts.text:

Oh man, you didn't prepare
what I asked for...
Do not forget what I asked.
scripts.translation:

别忘了我让你带什么。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
10 ^0000FFConches^000000
You didn't forget it, right?
Bring me these supplies, please.

请把这些材料带给我。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
You can feed your guild
with this food.
Come back with a friend.
scripts.translation:

这些食物可以喂饱你的公会。
和朋友一起来吧。

Bring me these supplies, please.
scripts.translation:

你没忘吧？
请把这些材料带给我。

scripts.text:

Oh! I really appreciate it.
Right on time!
I didn't have a white platter.
scripts.translation:

哦！非常感谢。
准时到了！
我正好没有白色的盘子。

scripts.text:

Thanks. It is nothing but
I will give you two sets of Sushi in return.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]

但我会给你两套明虾寿司作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Share it with your friends
and family members.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
和朋友家人一起分享吧。
欢迎再次光临。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh man, you didn't prepare
what I asked for...
Do not forget what I asked.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哎呀，你没准备我要求的东西...
别忘了我让你带什么。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I need a white platter:
1 ^0000FFChina^000000
You didn't forget it, right?
Bring it to me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
我需要白色的盘子：
1个 ^0000FF瓷器^000000
你没忘吧？
记得带给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
You are a really kind person.
You have brought everything
that I've asked you...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
你真是个善良的人。
你把我要求的东西都带来了...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
You are not the first foreigner
I have encountered. Amatsu is getting more and more tourists.
I just wanted to test you.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
你不是我遇到的第一个外地人。樱花城来的游客越来越多了。
我只是想考验一下你。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Your job was just errands but
I wanted to know...
how you devote yourself,
how serious you are about completing your job and not giving up.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
你的任务只是跑腿，
但我想看看...
你有多投入，
你对待完成任务有多认真，是否会半途而废。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I was thinking,
'If there is a person like that,
I would give that person everything about cooking that I have mastered
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
我在想，
“如果有这样一个人，
我会把我掌握的烹饪技艺全都传授给他。”

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
And.....
You...
You are the one.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
而且.....
你...
你就是那个人。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I'm old now. No one knows how long I can hold this knife. You have been chosen to inherit my culinary art...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
我年纪大了。没人知道这把刀还能在我手中握多久。你被选中继承我的烹饪技艺了...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Here, take my knife.
From now on, make fine cuisine with that knife.
...Learn how to slice a fish.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
拿着，这是我的刀。
从今往后，用这把刀做出精美的料理吧。
...学习如何切鱼。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
From now on, I will no longer ask you favors and give you fish slices in return....
Practice your skill with that knife and teach mainlanders the pleasure of fine cuisine...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
从今往后，我不再让你跑腿，也不再用鱼片回报你....
用这把刀磨练技艺，让大陆人体验精致料理的乐趣吧...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Wow...these are real hearts of
mermaid. The legends saying
that these could be found in another continent were true...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哇...这些是真正的美人鱼之心。传说在另一个大陆能找到的说法是真的...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Gathering all these must have been hard...Well, then.
Today, I will use all of my
ingredients to make a special cuisine for you!
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
收集这些一定很不容易...好了，那么。
今天，我会用我所有的食材为你做一道特别的料理！

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Give me a moment...
I shall show you my ^0000FFtrue culinary skill^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
请稍等...
我要向你展示我的 ^0000FF真正厨艺^000000。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Try these first.
Made from the freshest ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
先尝尝这个。
用的是最新鲜的食材。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Try these too.
My shop's fish slices are the best of the best!
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
也尝尝这个。
我店里的鱼片是最好中的最好！

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Have some more. Don't say no...!
Isn't it good? Huh? Isn't it good?
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
再吃点。别拒绝...！
好吃吗？嗯？好吃吗？

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Haha~! Not done yet!
It's okay, have some more!
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哈哈~！还没完呢！
没关系，再吃点！

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Take the leftovers.
You look stuffed...
Share the rest with your friends and family.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
剩下的你带走吧。
看你都吃撑了...
把剩下的分给你的朋友和家人吧。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Thanks a lot for today! Haha!
Come back again when you feel like helping. Take care...!!!
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
今天多谢惠顾！哈哈！
想帮忙的时候再来吧。保重...!!!

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh man, you didn't prepare
what I asked for...
Do not forget what I asked.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哎呀，你没准备我要求的东西...
别忘了我让你带什么。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
100 ^0000FFHearts of Mermaid^000000, okay?
You didn't forget it, right?
Bring me the supplies, please.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
100个 ^0000FF美人鱼之心^000000，好吗？
你没忘吧？
请帮我带这些材料来。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Holy cow~
This is a problem.....
There are so many customers, but I can't get all the ingredients that I need...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
天哪~
这下麻烦了.....
顾客这么多，但我没法买到所有需要的食材...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
This is horrible...
Some of my customers will not get
the chance to eat fine Amatsu cuisine...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
太糟糕了...
有些顾客将没有机会品尝到
美味的樱花城料理...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Well, well. Are you a customer?
Welcome. As always, my shop
highly values the freshness of
fish slices. What brings you down here...?
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哎呀，您是顾客吗？
欢迎光临。一如既往，
本店非常注重鱼片的新鲜度。
您来这里是有什么事吗...？

scripts.text: I would like to buy Sushi
scripts.translation: 我想买寿司

scripts.text: I would like to buy fish slice
scripts.translation: 我想买鱼片

scripts.text: Do you need assistance?
scripts.translation: 需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text: Keep up the good work
scripts.translation: 请继续加油

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Alright...! How many?
A set of Sushi is 700z. If you
want just 1 Sushi. It is 74z.
If you want more, tell me.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
好的...！要多少？
一套寿司是700z。如果只想要1个寿司，是74z。
如果要多，请告诉我。

scripts.text: 700z A set!
scripts.translation: 700z 一套！

scripts.text: 74z A piece!
scripts.translation: 74z 一个！

scripts.text: I will try it later
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh man, you don't have enough money.
If you want to eat delicious fish slices, you better bring more money.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哎呀，您的Zeny不够。
如果想吃美味的鱼片，最好多带点钱。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
There you go. If you like the taste, please order some more.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
给您。如果味道不错，请再点一些。

Oh man, you don't have enough money.
If you want to eat delicious Sushi,
you better bring more money.

如果想吃美味的寿司，

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

给您。如果味道不错，请再点一些。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Up to you. My Sushi is
the best of the best! The taste
and freshness are the best in the
world. If you have time, try my Sushi.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
随您。我的寿司
是最好中的最好！味道
和新鲜度都是世界一流的。
如果有时间，请尝尝我的寿司。

A set of fish slices is 350z.
1 fish slice is 37z.
If you want more, tell me.

一片鱼片是37z。
如果要多，请告诉我。

scripts.translation:

给您。如果味道不错，请再点一些。

[Magumagu]
Up to you. My fish slice is

scripts.translation:

随您。我的鱼片
是最好中的最好！味道
和新鲜度都是世界一流的。
如果有时间，请尝尝我的鱼片。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Haha~ YOU are the one who needs
assistance! Help others
when you can take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哈哈~ 需要帮助的是你吧！
能照顾好自己时，
也要帮助别人。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Some help would be great~!!
I was worried because we always
run out of ingredients...
Will you do me a favor?
I will reward you.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
如果能帮上忙就太好了~！！
我一直担心食材总是用完...
能帮我个忙吗？
我会给你报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I need some candies to make
a dessert for the customers.
Bring me ^0000FF10 Candy^000000.
It's not hard, right?
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
我需要一些糖果来给顾客做甜点。
请给我^0000FF10糖果^000000。
这不难吧？

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I need some crab shells to make
a sauce for my cuisine...
If you bring me ^0000FF10 Crab Shells^000000,
I will reward you.
Okay?
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
我需要一些螃蟹外壳来做酱汁...
如果你给我^0000FF10螃蟹外壳^000000，
我会给你报酬。
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I have used all of my conches.
I need it to make an appetizer...
Please bring me ^0000FF10 Conches^000000.
It is hard to find conches around here...
Please do me this favor.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
我的海螺都用完了。
我需要它来做开胃菜...
请给我^0000FF10海螺^000000。
这里很难找到海螺...
请帮我这个忙。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Decorative fish tails are out of
stock. This is urgent...
Please bring me ^0000FF10 fish tails^000000.
They are always missing when I need them badly...
Please do me this favor.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
装饰用的鱼尾缺货了。这很紧急...
请给我^0000FF10鱼尾^000000。
每次我急需的时候它们总是缺失...
请帮我这个忙。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
We are missing a platter to serve
fish slices to customers.
This is horrible...
Will you buy me some fine porcelain ^0000FFChina^000000?
I can't just put food anywhere...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
我们缺少用来给顾客上鱼片的盘子。
这太糟糕了...
你能帮我买一些精美的^0000FF瓷器^000000吗？
我不能随便把食物放在哪里...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Don't ask me why...
But, I need something special...
^0000FF100 Hearts of Mermaid^000000.....
I know that it sounds impossible, but it is really important to me...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
别问我为什么...
但我需要一些特别的东西...
^0000FF100美人鱼之心^000000.....
我知道这听起来不可能，但这对我真的很重要...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Don't ask any questions
about my request...
Just keep what I want in mind.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
别问关于我要求的问题...
只要记住我想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
We are missing a platter to serve
fish slices to customers.
This is horrible...
Will you buy me some fine porcelain ^0000FFChina^000000? I can't just put food anywhere...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
我们缺少用来给顾客上鱼片的盘子。
这太糟糕了...
你能帮我买一些精美的^0000FF瓷器^000000吗？我不能随便把食物放在哪里...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Well, good luck to you...
I will be waiting for you.
Don't forget what I asked...
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
好吧，祝你好运...
我会等着你的。
别忘了我让你带的东西...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Haha, you won't forget the flavor of my fish slice once you've
tasted it. If you have time, try my fish slices.
scripts.translation:
[马古马古]
哈哈，一旦你尝过我的鱼片，就不会忘记那个味道。
如果有时间，请尝尝我的鱼片。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
This is the great palace,
Toukoujyo.
Locals are prohibited
from entering...
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
这里是伟大的宫殿，
东宫城。
当地人禁止入内...

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Your attire looks unfamiliar.
Are you from another continent?
The lord has granted entrance to
tourists, so you can go in.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
你的穿着看起来很陌生。
你是来自其他大陆的吗？
领主允许游客进入，所以你可以进去。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Are you from Midgard?
Welcome to Amatsu.
Visit our lord in Chun-Su-Gak
when you go in.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
你是来自米德加尔特吗？
欢迎来到樱花城。
进去后请去春寿阁拜访我们的领主。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
He is really kind.
He invested in various fields for
Amatsu, and intercontinental trade was his idea.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
他真的很仁慈。
他为樱花城投资了各个领域，
洲际贸易也是他的主意。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Welcome. The lord of the palace
has specially allowed guests
from other continents.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
欢迎。宫殿的领主
特别允许来自其他大陆的
客人进入。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Look around and take your time.
Please enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
请随意参观，慢慢欣赏。
祝您在此度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
The lord is really nice guy.
Who would know that our town was
once a small village?
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
领主真的是个好人。
谁能想到我们这座城镇曾经只是一个小小的村庄呢？

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
I thank him for hiring me.
These days, he seems to have
troubles on his mind.
Lately, he's been looking pretty gloomy.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
我很感激他雇用了我。
最近，他似乎有心事。
看起来有些郁郁寡欢。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
You can't enter here.
The mother of our lord is resting in here. She needs her rest.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
你不能进去。
领主的母亲正在里面休息，她需要静养。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
She should regain her health...
But still, my lord is worrying so much.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
她应该会恢复健康的...
但即便如此，领主还是很担心。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Augh! I was suprised by that loud sound.
What happened? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
啊！我被那巨大的声响吓了一跳。
发生什么事了？什么？

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
The mother of our lord hasn't
fully recovered her health.
Still, she is better than before.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
领主的母亲还没有完全康复。
不过，她比之前好多了。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
If you are sent by my lord,
it is okay to enter...
But you wouldn't be able to cure
her. Many others tried and failed.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
如果你是受领主派遣来的，
可以进去...
但你无法治愈她。很多人都试过，但都失败了。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
She has been sick for months.
That is why she is staying in here.
It's a pretty fearsome sickness...
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
她已经病了几个月了。
所以她一直待在这里。
这是一种相当可怕的病...

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
You can't enter here.
The mother of our lord is resting in here.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
你不能进去。
领主的母亲正在里面休息。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Please, be quiet.
The mother of the lord is staying in here. She needs to relax.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
请保持安静。
领主的母亲正在里面休养，她需要放松。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Eh? Something was flying
in the sky... You didn't see? Ugh.
That sound suprised me.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
咦？刚才好像有什么东西在天上飞过...
你没看到吗？唉。
那声音吓了我一跳。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Now our lord is relieved.
We were so worrying about it so much.
Now, it is okay... *sob*.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
现在领主放心了。
我们之前真的很担心。
现在没事了... *抽泣*。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Oh...man. People from the other
continents are all doctors!
How many doctors have come to visit?! I can't even count anymore!
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
哦...天哪。来自其他大陆的人都是医生吗？
有多少医生来拜访过？我都数不清了！

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
She has been sick for months.
That is why she is staying in here.
...
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
她已经病了几个月了。
所以她一直待在这里。
...

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Why is this happening
to my kind lord...
How can it be? *Sob*...
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
为什么这种事会发生在仁慈的领主身上...
怎么会这样？*抽泣*...

scripts.text:
[Ichiro]
Welcome.
Our lord prepared guest rooms
for travelers like you.
scripts.translation:
[一郎]
欢迎。
领主为像您这样的旅行者准备了客房。

scripts.text:
[Ichiro]
If you are having any problems,
tell me. I would appreciate it if you talk to our lord of the
palace. This is all provided by him.
scripts.translation:
[一郎]
如果您有任何问题，请告诉我。
如果您愿意，可以和宫殿的领主谈谈。这些都是他提供的。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
I'm Jiro, the administrator
of this Palace. What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
我是次郎，这座宫殿的管理员。有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Issue me a Transit Permit
scripts.translation: 给我一张中转通行证

scripts.text: I want to live in Amatsu
scripts.translation: 我想住在樱花城

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
You already have one...
You don't need to have two of them.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
您已经有一张了...
不需要两张。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
Did you lose your Transit Permit?
You need to pay 10,000 zeny as a tax
to issue another Transit Permit.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
您的中转通行证丢了吗？
需要支付10,000 Zeny的税费
才能补办一张中转通行证。

scripts.text: Issue one
scripts.translation: 补办一张

scripts.text: Talk to you later
scripts.translation: 稍后再聊

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
There you go.
Don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
给您。
这次可别再弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
Okay, then...
Talk to me when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
好的，那么...
有需要帮助时再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
The lord announced that
he grants guests from Midgard the right to go anywhere.
You don't need me to issue you a Transit Permit.
scripts.translation:
[城门士兵]
领主宣布，
允许来自米德加尔特的客人自由前往任何地方。
您不需要我为您办理中转通行证。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
That is impossible. You're free to
go anywhere in Amatsu, but my lord doesn't want to concern himself with immigration.
Instead of that, you can stay here as long as you want.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
这不可能。您在樱花城可以自由前往任何地方，但领主不想介入移民事务。
相反，您可以想住多久就住多久。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
Well then...
Talk to me when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
那么...
有需要帮助时再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Saburo]
This is the training ground for improving our battle skills.
Please look around...
scripts.translation:
[三郎]
这里是提升战斗技巧的训练场。
请随意参观...

scripts.text:
[Saburo]
By the way, recently I've felt
like the soldiers have changed
lately. How do I say it...
Their faces are gloomy and
some of them are no longer around.
Have they gone to Midgard??
scripts.translation:
[三郎]
顺便说一句，最近我感觉
士兵们有些变化。该怎么说呢...
他们神情忧郁，
有些人也不见了踪影。
他们去米德加尔特了吗？？

scripts.text:
[Saburo]
In this job, I encounter
many strangers. But downstairs,
there's a guest from a distant land who seems suspicious...
I told my guards to watch him...
scripts.translation:
[三郎]
在这个职位上，我会遇到
许多陌生人。但在楼下，
有一位来自远方的客人看起来很可疑...
我让卫兵监视他...

scripts.text:
[Saburo]
Of course, my lord precisely knows everything that's going on.
Haha, don't take what I said seriously~
See ya...
scripts.translation:
[三郎]
当然，领主对发生的一切了如指掌。
哈哈，别太当真~
再见...

scripts.text:
[Shiro]
*Cough, Cough* What...
Don't talk to me...
*Cough, Cough*... Oh, my freakin' neck.
scripts.translation:
[白]
*咳嗽，咳嗽* 什...
别跟我说话...
*咳嗽，咳嗽*... 噢，我的脖子真难受。

scripts.text:
[Shiro]
That quack's cold medicine
is useless! I should never have trusted people from Midgard!
*Cough, Cough*...
scripts.translation:
[白]
那个庸医开的感冒药
一点用都没有！我早该知道不能相信米德加尔特的人！
*咳嗽，咳嗽*...

scripts.text:
[Shiro]
I don't know why but...
I'm getting worse and worse...
What kind of cold is this?
*Cough*... *Cough*...
scripts.translation:
[白]
我不知道为什么...
我的病情越来越严重了...
这是什么感冒？
*咳嗽*... *咳嗽*...

scripts.text:
[Goro]
*Psst*... Please, be quiet.
I will tell you a story, okay?
scripts.translation:
[五郎]
*嘘*... 请小声点。
我要给你讲个故事，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Goro]
There is a rumor in Amatsu.
The lord of this palace isn't
real... *Psst*, Quiet!
Don't panic and listen to me.
scripts.translation:
[五郎]
樱花城有个传闻。
这座宫殿的领主
不是真的... *嘘*，小声点！
别惊慌，听我说。

scripts.text:
[Goro]
There is a real lord behind
the kind lord and he is scheming
something. He is controlling
our town in some hidden place.
...Our kind lord is just a figurehead~!
scripts.translation:
[五郎]
在仁慈的领主背后
还有另一位真正的领主，他正在
策划着什么。他在某个隐秘的地方
控制着我们的城镇。
...我们仁慈的领主只是个傀儡~！

scripts.text:
[Goro]
It's for real! Trust me~
I saw him. The lord who was
laughing at the town on the
TenguGak!!
Just don't tell anyone that I've told you this, okay?
scripts.translation:
[五郎]
千真万确！相信我~
我亲眼见过他。就是那个在天狗阁上
嘲笑我们城镇的领主！！
拜托，千万别告诉别人我跟你说了这些，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rokuro]
He always talks nonsense.
He says that our lord
is not real, but a fake.
It's not even funny.
scripts.translation:
[六郎]
他总是在胡说八道。
他说我们的领主
不是真的，而是假的。
这根本不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Rokuro]
However, it is true that
recently, weird things are
happening. There were no
prohibited places before...
scripts.translation:
[六郎]
不过，最近确实发生了一些
奇怪的事情。以前这里
并没有禁止进入的地方...

scripts.text:
[Rokuro]
I hear strange sounds sometimes.
The mother of the lord has been
visited by doctors several times.
I guess her health hasn't
improve after their visits...
scripts.translation:
[六郎]
我有时能听到奇怪的声音。
领主的母亲
最近被医生探望了好几次。
我想她的健康状况
并没有好转...

scripts.text:
[Shichiro]
Have a good time.
My lord prepared some
guest rooms.
scripts.translation:
[七郎]
祝您玩得愉快。
领主大人为您准备了
客房。

scripts.text:
[Shichiro]
If you have any problems,
please call me. Also, try not to disturb the other guests.
scripts.translation:
[七郎]
如果您有任何问题，
请随时叫我。另外，请尽量不要打扰其他客人。

scripts.text:
[Shichiro]
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[七郎]
祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Hachiro]
My lord is inside.
If you'd like to greet him, feel free to enter.
scripts.translation:
[八郎]
领主大人在里面。
如果您想向他致意，请随意进入。

scripts.text:
[Hachiro]
Don't be rude in front of him.
He is somehow not feeling well.
Usually, he greets people from
other continents gladly, but...
What could have happened to him...?
scripts.translation:
[八郎]
在他面前不要无礼。
他最近身体不太舒服。
通常，他会很高兴地接待
来自其他大陆的人，但是...
他到底发生了什么事...？

scripts.text:
[Kyuro]
This is not good.
My lord is really kind, but
recently he is not doing well...
scripts.translation:
[九郎]
情况不妙。
领主大人非常仁慈，但
最近他状态不太好...

scripts.text:
[Kyuro]
I've heard about the rumors
but I trust him. He made
Amatsu into a great town.
That is why I'm following
him as a soldier.
scripts.translation:
[九郎]
我听说过那些传闻，
但我信任他。他把樱花城
建设成了一个伟大的城镇。
这就是我作为士兵
追随他的原因。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
What are you doing in here?
There is nothing interesting here.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
你在这里做什么？
这里没什么有趣的。

scripts.text: That is true
scripts.translation: 确实如此

scripts.text: Open the gate
scripts.translation: 打开大门

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
There are much better things to enjoy in town. Have a good time...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
城镇里有更值得享受的事物。祝您玩得愉快...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
You have the ticket...
Do you want me to send you now, or do you need a little instruction?
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
你有门票...
你想让我现在送你进去，还是需要一点说明？

scripts.text: I will go in
scripts.translation: 我要进去

scripts.text: Instruction, please
scripts.translation: 请给我说明

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
I will open the gate.
Take care of yourself...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
我会打开大门。
请保重...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
The area beyond this gate is
protected by some kind of magic.
You may get killed by someone
or get lost.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
这道门后面的区域
受到某种魔法的保护。
你可能会被人杀死
或者迷路。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
I can't tell you much.
I didn't go far inside and
and just took a quick look.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
我没法告诉你太多。
我没有深入内部，
只是匆匆看了一眼。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
First.....
'Do not trust what you are
seeing.' I don't know what
it means, but I guess you shouldn't believe everything before your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
第一.....
“不要相信你所看到的。”
我不知道这具体是什么意思，
但我想你不应该相信眼前的一切。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Second.....
'There are certain rules in
magic.' Everything has a
reason to exist. Magic is not an exception. You can probably find the answer...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
第二.....
“魔法有其特定的规则。”
万物的存在都有其理由，
魔法也不例外。
你大概能找到答案...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Well, I will open this gate.
Take care of yourself...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
好了，我会打开这道门。
请保重...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
I'm sorry.
You need a Transit Permit to go in.
Please, go back.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
很抱歉。
你需要中转许可证才能进去。
请回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
What gate are you talking about?
A gate? On the top floor of the building??? Surely, you must been be mistaken.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
你在说什么门？
门？在建筑物的顶层？？？
你肯定是搞错了。

scripts.text: Show him the ticket
scripts.translation: 出示门票

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
What? That pass is...?
That Transit Permit is from
the lord but I guess it has
been issued to the wrong person.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
什么？那张通行证是...？
那张中转许可证是领主签发的，
但我猜它发错人了。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
I will keep this ticket because
it was issued without permission.
This is a warning.
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
我会没收这张门票，
因为它是未经授权的。
这是一个警告。
小心点。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
There are more things to enjoy in town. Have a good time...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
城镇里还有更多值得享受的事物。
祝你玩得开心...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
There are more things to enjoy in town. Have yourself a good time...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
城镇里还有更多值得享受的事物。
祝你尽兴...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Do you want to go back?
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
你想回去吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do
scripts.translation: 是的，我想

scripts.text: I will stay here
scripts.translation: 我要留在这里

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
请保重。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Take care...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
保重...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
What! A foreigner...? *Phew*
I'm sorry, but I'm not in
the mood to meet new people!
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
什么！是外国人...？*呼*
很抱歉，我现在没心情见新人！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Get out! I'm not interested
in who you are.
I'm not feeling well!
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
出去！我不关心你是谁。
我不舒服！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
What! A foreigner? What brings
you here? If it is not urgent,
come to me another time...!
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
什么！是外国人？什么事把你带到这里？
如果不紧急，改天再来找我...！

scripts.text: I heard about your mother...
scripts.translation: 我听说你母亲的事...

scripts.text: Your last name is nice
scripts.translation: 你的姓氏很好听

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Oh...So you know about her disease?
I've heard that, in foreign lands,
the body of medical knowledge can
be quite amazing.
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
哦...原来你知道她的病情？
我听说，在外国，
医学知识非常渊博。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Welcome. As you know, I'm the
lord of Toukoujyo,
Ishida Yoshinaga. Nice to
meet you.
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
欢迎。如你所知，我是唐国城的城主，
石田 义永。很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Let's get to the point.
My mother is not doing well recently. I know you are here because of that.
Can you cure her disease?
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
我们直入正题吧。
我母亲最近身体不好。我知道你是为此而来的。
你能治好她的病吗？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Until now, many famous doctors
have visited her, but they
all failed to cure her disease
and made it worse...
They disappointed me.
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
到目前为止，许多名医
都曾来探望过她，但他们
都未能治好她的病，反而使病情加重了...
他们让我很失望。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
You, who hail from Midgard,
may be able to cure my mother's disease. I will reward you well if you succeed...
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
你来自米德加尔特，
也许能治好我母亲的病。如果你成功了，我会重重赏赐你...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
I beg you...Please.
My mother is living in a house outside of the palace.
Come to me when you finish your treatment.
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
拜托了...求你了。
我母亲住在宫殿外面的一栋房子里。
治疗结束后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Nice!? So What?!
Read my name until you get
tired of it! Darn it!
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
好听？！那又怎样？！
把我的名字读到你读腻为止！该死的！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Joking, even in this critical situation... *Phew*...
Please have a good time in Amatsu.
...Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
在这种紧要关头还开玩笑... *呼*...
祝你在樱花城玩得愉快。
...随便吧！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
...me? Don't you know? Huh?
I'm the lord of this palace.
If you don't know, talk to
the soldiers outside!
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
...我？你不知道吗？哼？
我是这座宫殿的城主。
如果你不知道，去问问外面的士兵！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
I've heard the great news!
My mother seems to have gotten better. What was her disease?
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
我听到了好消息！
我母亲似乎好转了。她得的是什么病？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
A fox? Is that so? Oh...
It wasn't a disease...!!
Why didn't I notice?!
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
狐狸？是吗？哦...
原来不是病...！！
我为什么没有发现？！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Darn fox. To run away and
take revenge on me in such a
way...Well, then. There's no chance of revenge now... Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
该死的狐狸。竟然跑掉，
还用这种方式报复我...好吧。现在没有报复的机会了... 哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Hmm, Mmm. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
嗯，嗯。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Anyway, thank you for helping me.
Mother will be okay now...
I want to reward you...
But what would be nice...?
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
总之，谢谢你帮了我。
母亲现在没事了...
我想赏赐你...
但是给什么好呢...？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Alright, I will give you
a Transit Permit.
You can go anywhere
with this ticket.
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
好吧，我会给你
一张中转通行证。
凭这张票你可以去任何地方。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
This isn't a big reward but
someday it will be useful for you.
Ask my soldier, 'Jyuro' about the details.
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
这不算什么大赏赐，
但总有一天你会用得上的。
关于细节，去问我的士兵“十郎”。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Hmm, I heard that my mother
got better...but
How can I know if you cured
her or not?
scripts.translation:
[石田 义永]
嗯，我听说我母亲
好转了...但是

scripts.text:

your treatment. I've been

Foreigners are always welcome.
scripts.translation:

knowledge from Midgard,

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
...Huh? Why are you here...?

scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
...咦？你怎么在这里...？
*呜...* 我头疼...
但我开始想起所有的事了...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
Thank you, traveler from a far off
land. I owe you a great debt... Thank you very much...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
谢谢你，来自远方的旅行者。
我欠你一份大恩...非常感谢...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
I will tell my son that
you exorcised the fox...
Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
我会告诉我的儿子，
是你驱除了狐狸...
谢谢你...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
I should get some rest.
My head aches, Young one.....
Go to my son...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
我该去休息了。
我的头很痛，年轻人.....
去找我的儿子吧...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
Oh, Are you...? You are the one
who exorcised the fox... Welcome.
Please, have a seat...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
哦，是你...？你就是
驱除狐狸的人...欢迎。
请坐...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
When I think over, being possessed
by the fox was my fault. I raised
my son badly... Oh~
He was a good boy when he was
young. I wasn't strict to him...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
回想起来，被狐狸附身
是我的错。是我没教育好儿子...唉~
他小时候是个好孩子。我对他不够严厉...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
Long ago, this town wasn't as big
as it is today. There was no big
palace like Toukoujyo. Then, one
day, my son brought great riches
to the village. He never told me what he did to earn that fortune...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
很久以前，这个城镇
没有现在这么大。也没有像东宫城那样的大宫殿。然后，有一天，
我的儿子给村庄带来了巨大的财富。他从未告诉我他是如何赚到这笔财富的...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
He built the palace and helped
the towners and make the town bigger.
He was perfect until...
he started doing strange things.
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
他建造了宫殿，帮助镇民，
让城镇变得更大。
他原本很完美，直到...
他开始做一些奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
Things...which angered God.
He learned forbidden magic,
performed experiments
in the palace, caged monsters,
did all sorts of horrible things...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
那些...惹怒了神明。
他学习了禁忌的魔法，
在宫殿里进行实验，囚禁魔物，
做了各种可怕的事情...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
That is the reason why there are
monsters in Toukoujyo... Finally,
God's wrath was unleashed. Even the Priest in the shrine couldn't help...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
这就是为什么东宫城里
会有魔物...最终，
神明的怒火爆发了。连神龛里的牧师也无力回天...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
At last, the anger came toward
me...It seems God tried to warn my son with the fox.
However, my son won't stop.
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
最后，怒火降临到了
我身上...看来神明是想用狐狸来警告我的儿子。
然而，我的儿子并没有停止。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
If it is okay, please stop my son.
I don't have much time.
I don't know what to do...
Please save this peaceful village.
I beg you please...
What is he truly thinking...?
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙织子]
如果可以的话，请阻止我的儿子。
我没有多少时间了。
我不知道该怎么办...
请拯救这个和平的村庄。
求求你了...
他到底在想什么...？

scripts.text:
[Tokako]
Er, I'm not really a shaman...
My friend, Takehue-kun brought
me here and invited me to try on these clothes.
scripts.translation:
[登香子]
呃，我其实不是萨满...
我的朋友竹笛把我带到这里，
邀请我试试这些衣服。

scripts.text:
[Tokako]
He asks me to do a lot of
weird stuff, but he is funny.
Sometimes, I don't know what
he is thinking. Still, he is a good friend.
scripts.translation:
[登香子]
他让我做很多奇怪的事情，
但他很有趣。
有时候，我不知道他在想什么。
不过，他是个好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tokako]
If you are curious about,
something, ask Takehue-kun.
He knows stuff about
mysticism and the occult that other people don't know about.
scripts.translation:
[登香子]
如果你对某些事情好奇，
去问竹笛吧。
他知道一些关于神秘学和超自然的知识，
那是其他人所不知道的。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Eh, you are a foreigner.
I'm sure you visited me because
you are having fox troubles.
I can see that in your face.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
啊，你是外国人。
我敢肯定你来访是因为
遇到了狐狸的麻烦。
我从你的脸上就能看出来。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Originally, the head priest should
help you, but this shrine has been
abandoned long ago.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
原本，大祭司应该
帮助你，但这座神龛
已经废弃很久了。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
It is hard to expel a fox from
a human body. If you have liquor
and noodles with fried bean curd,
it would be easy, but they are hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
要把狐狸从人体内赶出去很难。
如果你有酒和炸豆腐面，
那就容易多了，但它们很难找到。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
I know a little about foxes, so let me tell you something...
Foxes like to tease people but
it is rare for them to crave
vengeance.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
我对狐狸了解一点，让我告诉你...
狐狸喜欢捉弄人，但
它们很少渴望复仇。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
If a fox is vengeful, it means that a human caused it harm.
The fox will take its revenge
against, you, your family,
even your close friends!
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
如果一只狐狸充满复仇之心，
那就意味着有人伤害了它。
狐狸会对你的复仇
针对你、你的家人，
甚至你的亲密朋友！

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Anyway, a stronger spirit
will expel the fox from a human.
Come on, yell out and show me your spirit!
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
总之，更强大的精灵
会将狐狸从人体内驱逐。
来吧，大声喊叫，向我展示你的精神！

scripts.text: Taaaaah!!
scripts.translation: 嗷呜！！

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Good. Show that spiritual
energy to the fox several times.
Sooner or later, you'll be successful.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
很好。向狐狸多次展示你的精神力量。
迟早，你会成功的。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Don't forget. You also need the
the embodiment of animals stronger
than the fox. Without these, your
concentration will be of no use.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
别忘了。你还需要比狐狸更强大的动物化身。
没有这些，你的专注将毫无用处。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Eh? A foreigner. This shrine
has been without priests for a
long time. My friend, Tokako and I come here to play around.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
咦？是个外国人。这座神龛
已经很久没有牧师了。我和我的朋友登香子
来这里玩。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
If you have been chased by
monsters, please relax.
Monsters cannot come here, so
take a rest in here.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
如果你被魔物追赶，请放松。
魔物无法进入这里，
所以在这里休息一下吧。
